duty.a1.p: It moves on its own. Press the button at exactly the right moment to drop the box. Then do it again.
duty.a2.p: Match three boxes of the same color for a Three In A Row bonus. Management loves a pattern.
duty.a3.p: Stack more than half of your assigned quota before the boxes run out. Every fourth round includes a Promotion Review.
duty.a4.p: Spend your pay at the Fresnel Company Store. Over 100 office decorations, each one bending the rules of your workday.
